name: com.mailbuttons/mcp-server
title: Mailbuttons
description: Governed email for AI agents: a sandbox inbox to read and send from, human approval to go external.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: a scoped Mailbuttons MCP token, sent as 'Bearer mb_sandbox_...' (or mb_production_... once promoted). Get one free: sign in with an email code to get an mbk_ API key, then POST https://mailbuttons.com/api/v1/mcp/sandbox-inboxes with it. Guide: https://mailbuttons.com/developers/#mcp

environmentVariables.name: MAILBUTTONS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A scoped Mailbuttons MCP token (mb_sandbox_...). Sandbox-by-default; external send requires human promotion.

environmentVariables.name: MAILBUTTONS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Backend base URL. Defaults to https://mailbuttons.com; set for self-hosted or local.
